'''Race32c''' is a racing map by {{player|alice|flag=se}} that consist of sections from the standard maps: '''DM2, DM3, DM4, DM6, ZTNDM3 and AEROWALK'''. The title "race32c" is supposed to be associated to the suffix '''32c''' from the classical deathmatch map, [[Death32c]], which is a map based on iD Softwares dm-maps.

The intention of this map is to offer a racing with well known areas to move through as well as providing a longer type of racing map which is actually easy to finish without semi-impossible jumps and tricks, while still offer enough difficulty for to finish with a flawless flow.
